# Identity client + recipes

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Agent / harness · **Label:** `feature:identity-client` · **Epic:** [#116](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/116) · **Tickets:** 5 (1S 4M)

Extends the `warden identity` client from Phase 1 with agent keys and token exchange, and ships compose recipes for Claude Code and Codex CLI behind Warden. Any agent platform can wrap its processes with `warden identity exec` and carry an agent-bound, auto-refreshed Warden token without code changes.

## How we build it

- New tool `warden-identity` (new subcommand `proxy identity exec -- <cmd>` in cmd/proxy, extending internal/identityclient from Phase 1) that loads the agent key, gets a Dex token (device code flow against Dex), performs the exchange, and launches the child with the proxy environment pointed at a local forwarder.
- Claude Code recipe: Node env NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/certs/ca.crt and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1; Codex CLI recipe: SSL_CERT_FILE / CODEX_CA_CERTIFICATE for its Rust TLS stack plus HTTPS_PROXY.
- Child CLIs read HTTPS_PROXY once at start, so the wrapper runs a loopback forward proxy that injects the current token as `Proxy-Authorization: Basic session:<token>` on the upstream CONNECT to the worker; refreshes swap the header without restarting the child.
- Compose files deploy/compose/docker-compose.claude-code.yml and docker-compose.codex.yml: agent on `internal: true` network, only route out is the worker, Dex + CP alongside.
- Isolation proof: scripted check that direct egress fails, egress without a token fails in require mode, and decisions show the user sub.

## Done when

Both Claude Code and Codex CLI run from the compose recipes behind a require-mode worker, every request is attributed to the logged-in user, and the isolation script passes.

### 1/5 · W-P2-RCP-01

**Extend internal/identityclient with agent keys and token exchange**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#117](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/117)

Extend internal/identityclient (from W-P1-IDC-02) with Ed25519 agent keys (`warden identity enroll --agent-id` generates the key into a 0600 file and prints the public JWK for the agent registry), private_key_jwt client assertions, the RFC 8693 exchange against the CP token endpoint, refresh at 2/3 of the Warden token lifetime, and re-login when the subject token expires. Unit tests use httptest fakes for the issuer and the CP.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Refresh schedule test at 2/3 lifetime
- [ ] Subject expiry triggers device-code prompt
- [ ] Token never printed to stdout or logs

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-IDC-02`](identity-contract.md#23--w-p1-idc-02) Add `warden identity` CLI for login, token and proxy env; [`W-P2-TOKX-03`](token-exchange.md#35--w-p2-tokx-03) Mount POST /oauth2/token with RFC 8693 request parsing

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-RCP-02`](identity-client.md#25--w-p2-rcp-02) Add `proxy identity exec` wrapper with local token-injecting forwarder

### 2/5 · W-P2-RCP-02

**Add `proxy identity exec` wrapper with local token-injecting forwarder**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#118](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/118)

Add cobra subcommand `identity exec` in cmd/proxy that starts a 127.0.0.1 forward proxy injecting `Proxy-Authorization: Basic session:<current token>` on upstream CONNECT to the worker, sets HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY for the child to the local forwarder, execs the child and propagates exit code and signals. Token rotation swaps the injected header without restarting the child.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Child exit code propagated
- [ ] Rotation mid-session keeps open CONNECT tunnels and new ones use the new token
- [ ] Forwarder binds loopback only

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-RCP-01`](identity-client.md#15--w-p2-rcp-01) Extend internal/identityclient with agent keys and token exchange

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-RCP-03`](identity-client.md#35--w-p2-rcp-03) Add Claude Code compose recipe and docs; [`W-P2-RCP-04`](identity-client.md#45--w-p2-rcp-04) Add Codex CLI compose recipe and docs

### 5/5 · W-P2-RCP-05

**Add isolation proof script for recipes**

Type **test** · Size **S** · Issue [#121](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/121)

Add scripts/recipe-isolation.sh run against each recipe: from inside the agent container assert direct egress to the internet fails, egress via the worker without a token is denied (407) in require mode, and egress with the wrapper succeeds with the user's sub in the decision JSON lines.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Script exits non-zero if any check fails
- [ ] Runs for both Claude Code and Codex compose files

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-RCP-03`](identity-client.md#35--w-p2-rcp-03) Add Claude Code compose recipe and docs; [`W-P2-RCP-04`](identity-client.md#45--w-p2-rcp-04) Add Codex CLI compose recipe and docs
